name: Servo Plucked Strings GMB
summary: ESP32 firmware for robotic plucked-string instruments using dedicated servo fingers and a plucking actuator.

notes: README lists ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1, ESP32-WROOM-32 and ESP32 DevKit v1 profiles.

transports.notes: Default note transport uses UDP port 5006.

notes: README documents GMB SysEx discovery and capability reporting but the protocol version is not stated in the audited README excerpt.

mechanics.summary: Each equipped fret has a dedicated servo finger; a separate servo plucks or strums each string. Optional geared fingers let one servo serve two fret positions.
notes: Supports 1 to 6 strings and arbitrary equipped frets.

actuators.notes: One or more PCA9685 boards can be used; direct GPIO servo outputs are also supported.

notes: Servo rail should use a separate 5-6 V supply sized for worst-case current; do not power servos from the ESP32 regulator.

steps: Connect to the instrument access point.
Run the instrument wizard and calibrate every active fret finger.
Validate wiring and current limits before powered operation.

warnings: Project documentation states that full physical instrument validation is still pending.
